title: Add a grace period to plan definitions
description: Add a `grace_period_days` attribute to each plan definition, defaulting to 0, describing how many days a subscription stays active past renews_at before suspension. Wire it into the plan catalogue following the package conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Every plan definition carries a `grace_period_days` integer with a sensible default, exposed consistently with the other plan attributes.
